skill_isolation.limitation_note: Skills are staged into the self-contained plugin tree; skill-level isolation relies on repository and workspace boundaries since Grok Build loads plugin skills into the active session context.

forks.note: In headless automation, combine --fork-session with --resume or --continue to branch an existing conversation into a new session ID when shared history is needed; interactive /fork is omitted.

subagents.note: Custom subagents are dispatched with spawn_subagent and background: true; nesting is limited to one level so a subagent cannot spawn another child.

workflows.limitation_note: Interactive workflow creation via /create-workflow is omitted in headless automation; workflows must be pre-authored under .grok/workflows/ as Rhai files.

personas.note: Personas are behavioral overlays in .grok/personas/ defining task focus and input/output contracts (name, io_type, required, description) for subagents.

command_hooks.note: Grok Build enforces execution boundaries through deny rules, hooks, and shell-command ask rules paired with reviewed boundaries.

effort.limitation_note: The effort field in skill/agent frontmatter is accepted by Grok Build but not applied or enforced per official documentation; effort is unsupported for routing.

mode.limitation_note: Capability mode comes from the selected agent type or role definition, not a spawn_subagent argument; dynamic mode switching is unsupported.

allowed_tools.limitation_note: The allowed-tools field in frontmatter is accepted by Grok Build but does not grant or restrict tools under official documentation; per-agent tool filtering is unsupported.
